Below is the P6 router design-constraints report, built from a line-level read of every shipped bundle (the audit-data placeholder in the prompt arrived uninterpolated, so the per-bundle audit was reconstructed directly from source at `/Users/richengineer/@dev/engmanager.xyz/website/js/src/` and `website/src/components/*/script.js`, plus the page heads in `website/src/pages/*.rs`).

ROUTER CLASSES: `ONCE_GLOBAL` = execute exactly once per real page load, never re-execute, no per-swap work. `ONCE_GLOBAL+RESYNC` = singleton, but needs an onSwap rescan. `REINIT` = needs idempotent re-init against new `<main>`. `TEARDOWN_REINIT` = must dispose old-page state (observers/rAF/document listeners/body nodes) before re-init. `DELEGATED_OK` = document-delegated already, works with a small guard. `PAGE_OWNER_EXCLUDE` = owns URL/history or whole-page state; hard-navigate. `NON_DOM` = worker/worklet/SW, no DOM contract.

## 2. Minimal re-init convention

Contract (smallest viable):

```js
// shipped in a tiny shared bootstrap (or prepended to popover-registry.js),
// loaded on every page before all defer bundles
window.__engNav = (() => {
  const cbs = new Set();
  return {
    onSwap(cb) { cbs.add(cb); return () => cbs.delete(cb); }, // register once per real load
    _fire(main) { for (const cb of cbs) { try { cb(main); } catch {} } },
  };
})();
```

Router obligations: inside `document.startViewTransition`'s update callback, after swapping `<main>` + `document.title`, it must also (1) reconcile `<body>` classes/datasets (`homepage`, shop/checkout markers) and `<html>` page attrs, then (2) call `window.__engNav._fire(newMain)`. Scripts execute once per real load (head-diff dedupes by hashed filename and never re-appends an existing src); each callback receives the new `<main>` and must scope queries to it or be marker-idempotent (`data-*-bound`).

Files needing conversion (exact, for the router-eligible set = homepage/articles/search):

1. `search.js` — wrap form binding as `bind(root)` + `data-searchBound` guard; single delegated outside-pointerdown closer; `onSwap(bind)`.
2. `search-keyclick.js` — `data-keyclickBound` guard + onSwap rescan.
3. `fit-text.js` — `fit(main)`: prune `measurements` of detached SVGs, measure/observe new ones; onSwap.
4. `visited-articles.js` — `init(main)`: re-parse `#articles-data`, hydrate `.is-visited`, delegate clicks on main; onSwap.
5. `keyboard-nav.js` — move homepage check + link query inside the keydown handler (then needs no onSwap).
6. `big-cursor.js` — init/dispose pair; onSwap mounts on homepage, unmounts elsewhere (remove cursor div, disconnect MutationObserver, remove pointermove/toggle listeners).
7. `trash-drag.js` — export `stopDvdBouncer`/`initDvdBouncer`; onSwap stops old rAF and re-inits (drag delegation untouched).
8. `quick-actions.js` — `init(root)` + `data-qaBound`; onSwap.
9. `liquid-title.js` — onSwap: prune `titles` Set, `initTitle` new `[data-liquid-title]`.
10. `copy-code.js` — `onSwap(() => install())`.
11. `toc-waypoints.js` — init/dispose (disconnect IO, remove scroll + matchMedia listeners); onSwap.
12. `auteurs-shader.js` — per-canvas rAF handles + dispose; onSwap re-setup.
13. `comments.js` — init(main)/dispose (remove body popover form, document listeners, abort fetch); onSwap. Highest correctness priority (stale slug).
14. `region-map.js` — onSwap prune `instances` + rescan; depends on ordered leaflet injection.
15. `experiences.js` — single onSwap hook doing: speculation-rules rebuild, hover-discover re-bind, `.article`-scoped experience re-query. No other registration re-runs.
16. `theme-toggle.js` — delegate `[data-theme-cycle]` clicks; expose label re-sync called on swap (or router dispatches `engmanager:themechange` after swap, which liquid-title/region-map/Stripe appearance already listen to).

No conversion: `audio.js`, `popover-registry.js`, `view-transitions.js`, workers/worklet, excluded pages (`shop.js`, `checkout.js`, `not-found.js`). Nav cluster (`c-nav`, `nav-search-toggle`, `c-to-top`) needs no conversion ONLY if the router pins the shell (nav, to-top, `#api-receipt-modal`, `#article-reveal`, discovery-toast root, trash can) outside the swap — since nav config differs per page (Dropdown/Link/absent), this forces a server-side shell standardization decision before P6 lands.

## 3. Hard blockers / risks

Router blockers:
- **Dual history owners**: `shop.js` (pushState L1265/L1852, replaceState L915/L1368, popstate L2347) and `checkout.js` own their URLs. Router interception of `/shop`, `/products/*`, `/checkout*` will corrupt both state machines. Exclusion list is mandatory.
- **experiences.js receipt deep-links**: `setReceiptInUrl` pushes/replaces `?receipt` (L662-673) and its popstate handler (L699-706) toggles the modal. A Navigation-API router will see these as navigations. Rule: ignore same-document URL changes where only the `receipt` (and on shop pages `bag`/`image`) params differ; never fetch/swap for them, and don't let router popstate handling swallow the modal sync.
- **Double-exec of window singletons**: head-diff must be add-only and dedupe by src. Re-executing `popover-registry.js` (drops live close handlers), `audio.js` (orphans channels → un-cancelable overlapping SFX), `experiences.js` (doubles RUM senders, SW register, every document listener; re-runs `runAll`), `view-transitions.js` (double spring) are each a functional break.
- **SW registration/fetch scope**: sw.js registered with `scope:"/"` (experiences.js L2055, `Service-Worker-Allowed` from the Axum handler). Router HTML fetches are not navigations → no offline fallback, no navigation preload (sw.js L41-45). Router must fall back to `location.assign(url)` on fetch failure; optionally teach sw.js a header-keyed branch for router fetches.
- **Audio/theme continuity**: same-document swaps keep `__engAudio` clips playing (good) and `<html data-theme>` intact; the only gap is per-node theme-picker labels/listeners in fresh markup (fix in §2.16). `window.__engSfxUrls`/`__engUrls` are inline islands NOT covered by hashed-filename head diff — they are identical (content-hashed URLs) on every emitting page, so spec "first load wins" as an invariant and assert it.
- **Stale-closure hijacks**: keyboard-nav's captured links (ArrowDown preventDefault on non-home pages), comments.js stale slug, toc-waypoints/auteurs-shader leaked observers/rAF — these are correctness bugs, not just leaks, if conversion is skipped.
- **Script execution order on inject**: dynamically-inserted scripts are async by default. Prism autoloader requires prism-core first (articles.rs L268-269); region-map requires leaflet first (articles.rs L161-162); nav consumers require popover-registry first (its own header comment relies on `<head>` order). Head-diff must insert with `script.async = false` and preserve the new page's document order.
- **Per-page body-level islands**: nav variant, to-top, `#article-reveal`, receipt modal, toast root, trash can, JSON config islands all live outside `<main>` and differ by page. Swapping only `<main>` is insufficient as currently rendered — pick: standardize the shell on all router-eligible pages, or extend the swap surface (and convert the nav cluster per §1).

Speculation-Rules PRERENDER blockers (grep confirms ZERO `document.prerendering` guards anywhere in js/src or component scripts; prerender targets are article pages via experiences.js L2099-2121):
- `experiences.js:2962-2966` — wrap the whole bootstrap: `if (document.prerendering) document.addEventListener("prerenderingchange", runAll, {once:true})`. This single fix defers the worst offenders: SW register (L2055), BroadcastChannel creation (L853), battery read (L811), speculation-rules injection from inside a prerendered doc (L2117), RUM observers.
- `experiences.js:1766` — `setTimeout(() => sendRum("settled"), 5000)` fires `/__rum` from never-shown prerendered pages with pre-activation (garbage) vitals. Covered by the runAll gate, but additionally clamp metrics to `performance.getEntriesByType("navigation")[0].activationStart` post-activation.
- `experiences.js:1759-1765` — `sendRum("pagehide")`/`sendRum("hidden")` and `experiences.js:828-838` `navigator.sendBeacon("/health")` on pagehide: a DISCARDED prerender fires pagehide → spurious beacons. Guard inside the handlers: `if (document.prerendering) return` (discarded prerenders never flip the flag).
- `comments.js:271` — comments-list fetch at script eval: one GET per prerendered article (up to 3). Gate: defer init until `prerenderingchange` when `document.prerendering`.
- `region-map.js:162-219` (foottraffic article) — Leaflet boots and pulls tile.openstreetmap.org tiles during prerender (third-party traffic + OSM usage policy). Gate `initRegionMap` on `prerenderingchange`.
- `article-section-reveal.js:118` — `loadAnime()` warm import (jsdelivr) at eval; benign prefetch but gate with the same pattern if CDN traffic from unactivated pages matters.
- Storage-staleness (reads are legal in prerender but snapshot early): `theme-toggle.js:95` (theme could change pre-activation — add `prerenderingchange` → `apply(readStored())`), `visited-articles.js:60` visited set, shop/checkout cart counts. Re-hydrate on `prerenderingchange`.
- rAF loops (`auteurs-shader`, `not-found`, dvd bouncer) are browser-paused during prerender — no fix needed; Prism autoloader CDN fetches during prerender are cacheable and acceptable.

## 4. Head-asset-diff implications (page → script bundles)

- `/` homepage: SYNC theme-toggle; DEFER liquid-title, audio, search, search-keyclick, fit-text, big-cursor, keyboard-nav, view-transitions, visited-articles, trash-drag, quick-actions, experiences. Inline islands: `__engSfxUrls`, `__engUrls`; `#articles-data` JSON island inside `<main>`. No nav scripts.
- `/articles/:slug`: SYNC theme-toggle; DEFER liquid-title (title-effect articles), audio, prism-core (CDN), prism-autoloader (CDN, order-dependent), search, search-keyclick, copy-code, auteurs-shader, comments, toc-waypoints, article-section-reveal, view-transitions, quick-actions, experiences, c-nav, popover-registry, nav-search-toggle, c-to-top; PLUS leaflet (CDN) + region-map only when slug == `project-foottraffic` (articles.rs L130-163). Islands: `__engSfxUrls`, `__engUrls`.
- `/search`: SYNC theme-toggle; DEFER audio, search, search-keyclick, view-transitions, popover-registry, nav-search-toggle (nav Link variant — no c-nav.js, no c-nav.css).
- `/shop`, `/products/*`: SYNC theme-toggle; DEFER js.stripe.com/v3 (CDN), audio, shop. Islands `__shopProducts`, `__checkout`. EXCLUDED route.
- `/checkout`, `/checkout/success`: SYNC theme-toggle; DEFER js.stripe.com/v3, audio, checkout. EXCLUDED route.
- 404: SYNC theme-toggle; DEFER audio, not-found (+ `__wisp404` wasm island). EXCLUDED route.

What "loading a new page's scripts" means in practice for the router (eligible transitions only):
- home → article adds 10-13 scripts: prism-core+autoloader, copy-code, auteurs-shader, comments, toc-waypoints, article-section-reveal, c-nav, popover-registry, nav-search-toggle, c-to-top (+ leaflet+region-map on one slug). It "removes" fit-text/big-cursor/keyboard-nav/visited-articles/trash-drag — but the diff must be ADD-ONLY: already-executed bundles stay resident and are neutralized by their onSwap/dispose hooks, never unloaded.
- search → home adds: liquid-title, fit-text, big-cursor, keyboard-nav, visited-articles, trash-drag, quick-actions, experiences (first execution of experiences.js may happen mid-session here — its runAll executes against the post-swap document, which is fine exactly once).
- Diff keying: same-origin scripts by un-hashed logical name (assets.rs L117-118 already implements the reverse mapping `scripts/fit-text.a1b2c3d4.js → scripts/fit-text.js`) so a deploy mid-session (hash change) isn't treated as a new bundle — on hash mismatch for an already-loaded logical name, hard-navigate instead of mixing versions. CDN scripts keyed by full URL. Insert new scripts with `async=false` in new-page document order. CSS: add new `<link>`s before the swap resolves; deferred-tier links must replay the `media="print"`→`onload` flip; old page-scoped CSS may be removed only after the view transition finishes. Inline islands are invisible to filename diffing: `#articles-data` rides inside `<main>` (covered by the swap); `__engSfxUrls`/`__engUrls` are cross-page-identical (invariant to assert); `__shopProducts`/`__checkout`/`__wisp404` exist only on excluded routes, so the router never needs inline-script execution at all.
